parole.significato: A bench, as for rowers in a galley; also, a tier of oars.
parole.testo: Probably from French banc. Of Germanic origin, and akin to English bench.

parole.significato: A fortification or barrier such as a small earthen mound or ridge, a file of troops, etc.
parole.testo: Borrowed from French rideau (“curtain”), from Middle French rideau, from Old French ridel (“plaited stuff; cloth curtain; blind”), from rider (“to plait; to wrinkle”), perhaps from Old High German ridil (“a headband; a ribbon”) or rīdan, wrīdan (“to wrinkle”) (related to English writhe), from Proto-
